description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers.  We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time.  We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.
 


Bluesight is looking for a Data Engineer to help us redefine and grow our suite of data pipelines in support of the company's mission of powering hospital and pharmacy operations. Our customers rely on us to keep their patients safe and their pharmacies running smoothly while delighting them with every release. Through our pharmacy management and controlled substance tracking platforms, we're committed to improving medication management and compliance for our nation's healthcare providers; and our data operations form the backbone of that mission.
Data at Bluesight is a team sport. The pipelines you build will carry data from hospital systems, third-party sources, and our own applications into products that pharmacy directors and compliance teams use every day. That only works when engineers, product owners, analysts, and security partners design together—so this role is as much about how you work with people as it is about how you work with data.

You Can Expect To

 Build data transforms and pipeline tasks, with guidance and support from more senior engineers

 Learn and apply our ETL/ELT patterns, then help improve them as you identify where they can be better

 Write and refine queries to explore, validate, and explain the data you work with

 Understand the data contracts and commitments we make with other teams

 Implement data quality checks and monitoring, and learn to tell useful alerts from a noisy ones

 Debug pipeline and data issues, and explain afterward what went wrong and why

 Document what you build, both for fellow data engineers on your team, and for the teams supporting customers

 Take part in discussions about data modeling, quality, and governance, where good questions count as a contribution

 Exercise care in handling PHI and PII, guided by our engineering principles and the policies set by DevOps and Security

 Grow toward owning a data domain, and toward being the person teammates come to about it


Required Qualifications & Skills

 A bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience in a quantitative or data-intensive field

 Working skills in SQL-style or distributed (MapReduce, Spark, etc) querying, comfortable with different data types, joins and aggregations

 Programming experience

 Familiarity with version control and automated testing

 Understanding of ETL concepts and how data moves and transforms between systems

 Knowledge of, or curiosity about, tradeoffs in data modeling, storage, and other aspects of data engineering

 Clear communication about work, including flagging problems and blockers early, asking well-formed questions about problems, and willingness to help build knowledge from the answers

 Comfort taking on unfamiliar problems, knowing your team is available for help

 Comfort giving and receiving feedback in code reviews to help the whole team improve over time

 Attention to detail, especially regarding correctness in data


Preferred Qualifications

 Experience building robust data pipelines

 Experience with pipeline orchestration and monitoring

 Experience in a cloud environment or other environment with "infrastructure as code"

 Experience handling regulated or sensitive data

 Knowledge of or interest in healthcare data (e.g. EHR, FHIR, automated dispensing systems, purchasing reports)


This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.
 
Why Bluesight?
Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it.  We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters.  Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!
-Competitive salary
-Time off when you need it – unlimited vacation days!
-Generous insurance coverage
-401k program with a company match
-Fun, collaborative culture!
 
EOE AA M/F/VET/Disability
 
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws.
